name: Buckled Hardwood After a Leak in Renton: Repair or Replace
title-tag: Buckled Hardwood After a Leak in Renton: Repair or Replace
meta-description: Buckled boards can't be refinished back down — but most leak-damaged Renton floors are repairable: dry, weave in new boards, refinish the room at $3.99/sq ft.
post-summary: November 2, 2026 · Buckling — boards lifting off the subfloor — is the one water-damage grade refinishing alone can’t fix, but it rarely means a whole new floor: dry it fully, weave in matching boards, then refinish the room at $3.99/sq ft so the repair disappears. When replacement honestly wins, what insurance wants, and why Renton’s Boeing-era oak survives this better than most.
